user_info.name: Harsha (sappamanoharsha)
user_info.notes: Complete face, hair, and styling analysis - all data important for tracking

shape_analysis.face_proportions: wider than average, benefits from added height on top

color_recommendations.best_clothing_colors: earthy tones (olive, rust, camel, terracotta), jewel tones (navy, forest green, burgundy, deep teal), crisp white and off-white, warm neutrals (tan, chocolate brown, warm gray)
color_recommendations.avoid_colors: washed-out pastels, neon, cool grays, icy blue

styling_notes.face_shape_tips: To create illusion of length, add height on top and keep sides tight. Beard filling the chin area helps elongate the face.
styling_notes.feature_enhancement: Define curls, clean beard neckline, use warm lighting
styling_notes.camera_angles: Slightly above eye level, angled 3/4 shows best side. Full front good for avatar base shots.
styling_notes.lighting_tips: Use warm front lighting (not cool/blue). Skin tone reads best under warm white or golden light.

analysis.color: dark brown-black (near-black base, slight olive-brown in light)

styling.recommended_cuts: 1) Textured curly crop - keep natural curl on top, tight fade on sides. 2) Modern quiff/wavy quiff - push volume forward and up. 3) Mid-fade with volume on top. 4) Edgar cut (curly) - blunt fringe version.
styling.product_recommendations: Light curl cream or sea salt spray to define 2B/2C waves without weighing them down. Avoid heavy gels that flatten natural texture.
styling.styling_tips: Style with product to define curls before recording/photos. HeyGen captures texture well when defined, not fluffy.
styling.maintenance_schedule: Regular trims to maintain shape, define curls with product

recommendations.style_suggestions: 1) Maintain current stage with clean edges for polished medium stubble. 2) Grow to full short beard (4-5 weeks) for more jaw definition. 3) Corporate stubble (3-5mm all over) for professional content.
recommendations.grooming_tips: 1) Define neckline 1-2 fingers above adam's apple. 2) Sharpen cheek line - gentle diagonal from sideburn to mustache corner. 3) Keep chin full for face shape. 4) Clean up before recording sessions.
recommendations.product_recommendations: Beard trimmer, beard oil, precision razor for lines
recommendations.maintenance_schedule: Weekly edge cleanup, monthly full trim

heygen_avatar_tips.lighting: Use warm front lighting (not cool/blue). Skin tone reads best under warm white or golden light.
heygen_avatar_tips.background: Dark navy, deep green, or warm charcoal contrast well against complexion.
heygen_avatar_tips.wardrobe: Solid colors work best. Navy, olive, burgundy, or crisp white collared shirt. Avoid busy patterns.
heygen_avatar_tips.hair_prep: Style with product to define curls - HeyGen captures texture well when defined, not fluffy.
heygen_avatar_tips.beard_prep: Clean up neckline before recording sessions. Sharp edges photograph/video better than natural borders.
heygen_avatar_tips.camera_angle: Slightly above eye level, angled 3/4 shows best side. Full front good for ID/avatar base shots.

quick_reference.skin_tone: Deep warm brown (Fitzpatrick IV-V, warm undertone)
quick_reference.beard: Medium stubble | ~2-3 weeks | dark brown | needs edge cleanup
quick_reference.best_colors: Olive, navy, rust, burgundy, forest green, cream, white
quick_reference.avoid_colors: Pastels, neon, cool grays, icy tones
